setup.name: ZK
reasons: 15M score 50/100 measures deterministic rule agreement, not probability of profit.
15M decision uses closed 4H bullish / 1H bullish / 15M neutral EMA trends; 15M RSI 43.1, ATR 1.35%. All displayed context closes by this decision candle.
Relative 15M volume 0.54× versus the previous 20 15M bars; actual 24-bar 15M taker-buy base-volume share 44.1%.

UTC-session VWAP uses reported quote/base volume totals from 15M bars. The last 48-bar 15M candle volume profile and POC are approximate: volume is spread uniformly across each candle's high-low range, not measured from trade-level volume at price.
Order blocks, liquidity sweeps and FVGs are causal price-action heuristics, not proof of institutional orders or future fills. Pivots require two right-side closed candles before use.

Conditional 15M plan: wait for relevant EMA trend alignment, a fresh bullish 15M closed-candle structure confirmation, positive required MACD momentum, and sufficient 15M taker-buy volume before entry.
confirmations: Await 4H and 1H and 15M bullish EMA agreement
Await a fresh bullish 15M BOS, CHoCH, sweep recovery or 20-bar breakout
Await positive 15M and 1H MACD momentum
Await 15M relative volume ≥1.1× and actual taker-buy share ≥52%
invalidations: Stop 0.01664 is a fixed simulated exit level; a gap can cause a larger realized loss.

A new bearish closed 4H and 1H and 15M EMA trend requires reassessment and prevents new 15M long qualification. Published simulation entry, stop and targets stay fixed; trend changes do not trigger an automatic exit.
Unfilled 15M recommendations expire 6 hours after their decision candle; maximum simulated hold after entry is 18 hours. Reassess after any data gap or exchange outage.

analytics.dataSource: Binance public spot REST (https://data-api.binance.vision); closed 1h/4h klines
notes: Evaluation scope: two fixed baseline strategies. Scanner recommendations are evaluated separately in the immutable signal ledger; technical setup scores are not calibrated win probabilities.
Real closed Binance spot 1H/4H OHLCV; no fabricated history or trade execution.
Two fixed rules; no parameter optimization. 200 hourly bars warm up indicators; the next half initializes training, then three expanding-train / disjoint-test folds run chronologically.
All returns, win rate, drawdown and expectancy use percentage points; profit factor is a ratio. Expectancy is mean net trade return. Undefined win rate, profit factor or expectancy is null.

Equity, trade statistics, totalReturn and testReturn cover only concatenated nonoverlapping test folds. trainReturn is the arithmetic mean of overlapping expanding-training fold returns, never their sum.

Decisions use close t and only 4H candles closed by t; entries and signal exits use open t+1. Fee 10 bps plus adverse slippage 5 bps on each side. One unlevered position, all available cash, fractional quantities; exchange lot/tick rounding and capacity are not modeled.

Known opening stop/target events resolve before later intrabar extremes. Otherwise stop-first for ambiguous OHLC; gap-through stops use the worse open, while favorable target gaps fill at the fixed target. No target fill on an entry bar. Stops remain active. Maximum hold 72 hours; predeclared fold boundaries flatten at the final bar open with both exit costs.
Drawdown uses hourly equity including estimated liquidation costs, not an intrabar worst-case path. No fees for idle cash, funding, shorting, leverage, tax or liquidity impact beyond fixed slippage.
Degradation and low-sample flags are descriptive; these short, single-symbol folds do not prove robustness, eliminate overfitting, or estimate a probability of future profit.
EMA 21/50 + RSI momentum: low sample (19 out-of-sample trades; warning threshold 30).
EMA 50 + RSI pullback: low sample (0 out-of-sample trades; warning threshold 30).

ruptures offline visualization: at most 1000 recent closed 1H log-return / absolute-return observations, full-window standardization, PELT l2 penalty 3*log(n), minimum segment 24 hours; terminal marker excluded. Never used for entries or validation.

River ADWIN receives abs(hourly log return)/0.05 clipped to [0,1], one closed candle at a time; no fitted full-sample scaling. driftDetected means at least one alert in the analyzed window; detection times: none. Drift is descriptive and does not enter strategy decisions.

pandas-ta-classic 0.8.32 independent native reference check after 200-bar warmup: EMA PASS (max absolute error 0; tolerance 8.72e-06); RSI PASS (max absolute error 3.55e-14; tolerance 1e-06). Differences are reported; the optional reference never replaces strategy inputs.

QuantStats 0.0.86, EMA 21/50 + RSI momentum: hourly equity max drawdown 8.947%; daily UTC Sharpe -8.939 (365 periods/year, risk-free 0). Uses supplied costed out-of-sample equity only; no benchmark download or HTML report.

QuantStats 0.0.86, EMA 50 + RSI pullback: hourly equity max drawdown 0.000%; daily UTC Sharpe not defined (flat equity, no trades) (365 periods/year, risk-free 0). Uses supplied costed out-of-sample equity only; no benchmark download or HTML report.
Historical data cutoff: 2026-10-18T01:04:55.186Z. Reproduce using --symbol BTCUSDT --limit 1000 --as-of 2026-10-18T01:04:55.186Z; upstream candle revisions can still change a later download.

regime.method: Causal EMA21/50 current regime; ruptures 1.1.10 PELT(l2), RETROSPECTIVE ONLY; River 0.26.1 ADWIN online volatility drift

notes: Replay of the actual analyzeSymbol, publishSignals, advanceSignal, reservePosition and applyPaperUpdates engines. cx-spot-5 adds a BTC/breadth regime gate, a frozen calibrated edge model, volatility/beta position sizing, and TP1 scale-out with breakeven and ATR trailing exits.

The model and its exit profiles were trained only on data that ends before this replay window starts (see model.trainedThrough and model.outOfSample). The replay is therefore out-of-sample for the model; it is still a single historical period.

Predeclared twelve-market universe of liquid majors plus INJ (the user-reported case). Each symbol/horizon is a separate 10,000 USDT account; BTC trend and breadth come from the same universe at each scan. Risk budget is 1% of initial capital, reduced by volatility, beta and 15M guidance.

Hourly scans at :17 are an assumed publication time. Each input uses 259 closed bars per frame, matching 260 live klines minus the unfinished bar. Historical 24h ticker volume/change is reconstructed from 24 closed hourly bars. Current exchange filters and a fixed present-day universe introduce selection limitations.

New entries ignore any execution candle already underway at publication. OHLC fills are assumed, not trade-level verified. Stops win ambiguous bars, including a same-bar TP1 followed by a dip to breakeven. The scaled-out portion is reported in one quantity-weighted exit price.

Summaries pool every symbol's completed trades per horizon. Expectancy is in R (net return divided by planned costed risk). The 90% bootstrap interval and the 95th-percentile Monte Carlo drawdown (shuffled trade order) describe sampling uncertainty; 'validated' needs at least 100 trades and a positive lower bound.
Positive history is not proof of future profit. Fewer than 30 completed trades in a row is a sample-size warning, not a formal significance test.
